notes: Direct HTTP fetch (curl, Shopify storefront JSON endpoints), no blocking, per prior pass's access notes. Enumerated all 161 site collections via /collections.json (2 pages, page 2 empty, confirming full list), then keyword-scanned titles/handles for pet/dog/cat/animal/kennel/leash/collar/litter/scratch/aquarium/carrier/harness/feeder/bowl/puppy/kitten/bird terms. Found 3 candidates: 'Pets' (handle pets, 12 products), 'TP PETS' (handle tp-pets, 24 products), 'TOILETPAPER PETS - FOLDING CHAIRS' (handle toiletpaper-pets-folding-chairs, 6 products, a subset of TP PETS). Inspected each via /products.json: 'Pets' is the PETS (R)EVOLUTION x United Pets line -- literal pet products (ceramic bowls, bowl mats, kennels) for feeding/housing dogs and cats -- included as Pet Care. 'TP PETS' and its FOLDING CHAIRS subset are the Toiletpaper x Seletti designer collab whose 'PETS' theme is a cat/dog-illustration print applied to human furniture and accessories (folding chairs, cushions, bath mats, beauty cases) -- pet-themed, not pet-care per the boundary rules; excluded, and not double-counted since FOLDING CHAIRS is fully contained in TP PETS. Also checked the 'Bowls' collection (37 products, tableware) for any pet-bowl overlap with the 'Pets' collection -- none found (disjoint product sets). No litter, collar, leash, carrier, kennel-standalone, aquarium, or feeder collections exist independently of the 'Pets' collection. Site search was not relied on for absence proof; the full collections.json enumeration serves as the absence check.

rows.evidence: https://www.seletti.it/collections/pets/products.json?limit=250 returned 12 products (exhaustive, single page); matches collections.json products_count=12 for handle 'pets'
